description: T-040: SYSOP INITIALIZE -1 on a staged m2 sysop (@USER@), the original only: how far its start-up cycle has come. Under MBBSEmu every record cache is at its floor and the cycle crawls; m2_live.sh waits for `(Finished)` before play. silvermere drops the command (no record caches).

steps.note: MBBSEmu admits one connection per user; the previous sheet's session can still be held for a moment after its logoff ("... is already logged in -- only 1 connection allowed per user", live run 38953732059)
wait for the original to let the previous session go
the name again at the Username prompt MBBSEmu shows after the refusal
a negative rate only shows the start-up cycle: its progress, maxactive and state; it never restarts it
